Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 21, 2026

Cup Season is operated by Fischbeck3 LLC. This page says what we collect, why, who else touches it, and how you leave.

What we collect

  • Your account. Your name, email address and handle; your marker; your city and home course if you add them; a profile photo if you choose one.
  • Your golf. The rounds you post (score, course, tees, date), your handicap index and how it was set, the leagues you join and what happens in them (points, standings, board posts, comments, applause), the live games you score, and any photos you attach to a round.
  • Your device. A push token, only if you turn notifications on. Basic diagnostics — crash and error reports and which screens were opened — so we can fix what breaks.
  • Your contacts, only if you ask. When you tap to find friends, we check your contacts against golfers who are already here. We send salted hashes, never your contacts, and we keep nothing that doesn't match.

What we use it for

To run your account, your leagues and the standings; to send sign-in codes and league updates; to fix the app. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising.

Who else touches it

  • Supabase — the database, sign-in and photo storage.
  • Brevo — delivers sign-in codes and season emails.
  • Netlify — serves the web app.
  • GolfCourseAPI — course ratings and slopes, fetched by our server; it never sees you.
  • Anthropic — reads a scorecard photo you choose to scan so the scores can be typed for you. Your photo is not used to train its models.

Each holds only what its job needs.

How long we keep it

While your account exists. You can delete your account from Settings on the web or the phone: your photos and device tokens are deleted, your email address is removed from your profile, and your account is closed at once. Rounds you posted into a league stay in that league's record as "Former member", because the standings built on them stay true. Deleted data leaves our live database immediately and our backups on their own rolling schedule.

Age

You must be at least 13 to use Cup Season.

Apple

Apple is not a sponsor of, and is not involved in, any league, competition or pot run through Cup Season.

Questions or requests: jerecho@fischbeck3.com.

By using Cup Season, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

Terms of Service

Last updated: September 21, 2026

Cup Season is operated by Fischbeck3 LLC. By using it you agree to these terms.

Who can use it. You must be at least 13. A league that keeps a pot is a private arrangement between adults who know each other; see the Prize Pool Disclaimer.

Your account and your scores. You are responsible for the accuracy of what you post — your scores most of all. A posted round is a fact in your leagues' records: you can delete it, and a league's Pro can rule on points with a reason everyone can read, but a round is never edited after the fact.

Your content. You keep ownership of your photos and content. You give Cup Season permission to display them where the service needs to — on your card, your leagues' boards, and the cards you choose to share.

The app. Cup Season is provided "as is", without warranties. We may change or retire features. We may suspend or remove accounts that misuse the service or other golfers.

Disputes between golfers. Scores, points and pots are settled inside your league, by its Pro and its members. Cup Season keeps the record; it does not arbitrate.

Questions: jerecho@fischbeck3.com.

Prize Pool Disclaimer

Last updated: September 21, 2026

Cup Season is a golf league app for private groups who play real, handicapped golf together.

Cup Season keeps the ledger; the money moves between friends. Any pot shown in the app is a private arrangement among players who know each other, set up and settled by the league's organizer and its members. It is based on skill — real golf scores under a handicap — and is not a game of chance operated by Cup Season.

Cup Season does not collect, hold, transfer or distribute money, and takes no fee or cut of any pot. A league's stake is capped at $200 per golfer per season. Cup Season is not responsible for a league's payouts or disputes.

Apple is not a sponsor of, and is not involved in, any league or pot.

You are responsible for making sure your league complies with the laws where you play. If you are unsure whether a money pot is allowed where you live, keep your league to bragging rights.
